facts.description: Bike in the Burgundy of California! Rates • Adult $250 Ages 17 and up • Child/Teen $126.75 Ages <15 Time 10:00AM - 3:30PM About Wide open spaces, lots of fantastic Pinot Noir, Chardonnays and other great wines. Quiet roads Fun, smaller family owned wineries. Close to Napa but far from the all the crowds. Only 10 minutes from Napa and usually cooler than the rest of the Napa Valley, the Carneros is becoming a guest favorite. There are quiet roads to bike along, great wineries that are some of our guide's favorites. You can see for miles here and being so close to San Pablo Bay you can get whiff of the sea air. Rolling hills and never ending vineyards. Come bike with us in the Carneros! Meeting Location • 6 Cuttings Wharf Rd, Napa CA Includes • Use of a high quality Specialized Town bike, helmet, unlimited bottled water, Wine Country picnic lunch, and professional local guides. Wineries we may visit • Etude, Bouchaine, Ceja, Mckenzie Mueller, Calmere, Sainstbury among others
